query: Identify jurisdictions in Pakistan whose local government differs from the standard first-level division / municipality model — in particular the national capital. For each: explain how its governance differs, name its sub-units (e.g. boroughs) and their councils, and list EVERY sub-unit with the head's title (English and local), how the head is selected, and the current officeholder as of 2026-11-14 (full name, party, term start/end) with source URLs.

jurisdictions.name: Islamabad Capital Territory
jurisdictions.why_distinct: Federally administered capital, not a provincial municipality. The 2026 ordinance proposed three town corporations with union councils and indirectly chosen mayors, and 130 union councils were delimited. By 14 November 2026 the ordinance had lapsed; the 2015 one-metropolitan-corporation/125-union-council framework had revived and the High Court suspended the election schedule. The three listed towns are the published 2026 delimitations, NOT confirmed functioning elected councils; none has a confirmed incumbent mayor. The operative boundaries remain before the court.

jurisdictions.name: Karachi Division
jurisdictions.why_distinct: Three-tier urban local government: Karachi Metropolitan Corporation/City Council, 25 town municipal corporations and their town councils, and union committees. Unlike an ordinary standalone municipality, the metropolitan body overlays town-level councils; town chairmen are selected by the town councils rather than directly by residents. The names below are the 2023 returned town heads; a town-by-town 2026 incumbency confirmation is unavailable for some, so later replacements cannot be ruled out. Four-year terms run from oath, but an exact end date is not confirmed for each head.
